caption: The drawing depicts a single garment, specifically a shawl or cloak, centered on a plain, light beige background. The shawl hangs loosely and features a button or clasp at the top and overlap in the center, suggesting it is fastened around the neck. The fabric is dark in tone with an intricate repeating pattern of light-colored, stylized leaves distributed evenly across the surface. The bottom edges of the shawl are pointed and adorned with a fringe that varies in length along the border. There are no other objects or elements in the composition, and the drawing is rendered in shades of black, gray, and white, with fine detailing to convey texture and shape. Handwritten text is faintly visible below the drawing, with words at either end of the lower edge.
title: Shawl
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
